seed_enumeration: all 2048 vectors in ascending binary coefficient order; solve x^3+z*x^2+1=0 for every z
factor_base: cofactor-project every curve point over each nonzero x root, remove identity, close under sign and Frobenius
folding: one column per signed-Frobenius orbit; canonical polynomial-coordinate pair across 83 Frobenius rotations and both signs
selection_rule: evaluate geometry and circuit cost before any target run; larger B alone is not an end-to-end result
